title: Back and Pelvic Pain in Pregnancy — Examine, Reassure and Support

hook.en: Almost half of pregnant women have back or pelvic pain, and many are told "it's normal, wait for the baby". Learn to tell the types apart, examine safely and offer real help.
hook.ur: Takreeban aadhi hamila khawateen ko kamar ya pelvic dard hota hai, aur bohat si ko kaha jata hai "yeh normal hai, bachay ka intezaar karein". Qismein alag karna, mehfooz examination aur asli madad dena seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll separate pelvic girdle pain from lumbar pain, use the posterior pelvic pain provocation (thigh thrust) test and the active straight leg raise, and plan support, exercise and advice that are safe in pregnancy.
goal.ur: End tak aap pelvic girdle pain ko lumbar dard se alag karenge, posterior pelvic pain provocation (thigh thrust) test aur active straight leg raise istemal karenge, aur hamal mein mehfooz support, exercise aur mashware ka plan banayenge.

text.en: **Pelvic girdle pain** is felt between the back of the pelvis and the buttock, often on one or both sides, sometimes also at the pubic bone at the front. It is worse with **turning in bed, climbing stairs, standing on one leg and walking**. **Lumbar pain** is centred higher in the lower back. The two can occur together. Most pelvic girdle pain **improves after birth**, but good care makes pregnancy much easier.
text.ur: **Pelvic girdle pain** pelvis ke peechay aur kulhay ke beech hota hai, aksar ek ya dono taraf, kabhi samne pubic haddi par bhi. Yeh **bistar mein karwat badalne, seedhiyan chadhne, ek taang par kharay hone aur chalne** se barhta hai. **Lumbar dard** neeche ki peeth mein oopar ki taraf hota hai. Dono saath bhi ho sakte hain. Zyada tar pelvic girdle pain **paidaish ke baad behtar** ho jata hai, magar achhi care se hamal bohat aasan ho jata hai.

text.en: Think of the pelvis as a **ring held by three joints**: the two at the back (sacroiliac) and the one at the front (pubic symphysis). Pregnancy hormones soften the ligaments so the ring can widen for birth. When one side takes more load than the other, the joints can become irritable, like a door hinge that squeaks. Support and balanced loading calm it.
text.ur: Pelvis ko **teen joints se bandha hua halqa** samjhein: peechay do (sacroiliac) aur samne ek (pubic symphysis). Hamal ke hormones ligaments ko narm karte hain taake halqa paidaish ke liye phail sake. Jab ek taraf zyada load pare to joints chirchire ho sakte hain, jaise darwaze ka kabza jo cheekhta hai. Sahara aur barabar load unhein sukoon dete hain.

title.en: Assessing pelvic or back pain in pregnancy
title.ur: Hamal mein pelvic ya kamar ke dard ki assessment

steps.title: Locate and screen
steps.detail: Ask where it hurts, what makes it worse and whether there is bleeding, fever, urinary symptoms, severe headache or leg weakness. Screen first for anything that needs the midwife or doctor. || Jagah maloom karein aur screen karein

steps.title: Provoke the pelvic joints
steps.detail: Use the posterior pelvic pain provocation (thigh thrust) test lying on the back, with pressure along the long dorsal ligament, and the active straight leg raise. Reproducing the usual pain supports a pelvic cause. || Pelvic joints ko provoke karein

steps.title: Check the back and nerves
steps.detail: Test lumbar movement, the legs' strength and sensation and reflexes. Pain down the leg with weakness or numbness points to a nerve root, not the pelvic joints. || Peeth aur nerves dekhein

steps.title: Plan support and exercise
steps.detail: Explain the cause simply, advise on positions and activity, consider a pelvic support belt and give gentle stabilising and walking exercises. Review every two to three weeks. || Support aur exercise ka plan banayein

question.en: Pain at the back of the pelvis, worse turning in bed and climbing stairs, with a positive thigh thrust test. What does this suggest?
question.ur: Pelvis ke peechay dard, bistar mein karwat badalne aur seedhiyan chadhne se barhta hua, thigh thrust test positive. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: A disc prolapse with nerve compression
text.ur: Disc prolapse nerve ke dabao ke saath

feedback.en: That causes leg pain with neurological signs.
feedback.ur: Yeh neurological nishaniyon ke saath taang ka dard paida karta hai.

feedback.en: Yes — this pattern with a positive provocation test supports a pelvic joint cause.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh pattern positive provocation test ke saath pelvic joint ki wajah ki taeed karta hai.

text.en: A normal change that needs no help
text.ur: Normal tabdeeli jise madad nahi chahiye

feedback.en: Treatment helps even when the cause is pregnancy.
feedback.ur: Wajah hamal ho tab bhi ilaj madad karta hai.

title.en: Pelvic girdle pain or lumbar pain?
title.ur: Pelvic girdle pain ya lumbar dard?

rows.en: Between the pelvis and buttock, sometimes the pubic bone
rows.ur: Pelvis aur kulhay ke beech, kabhi pubic haddi
Pelvis ke oopar neeche ki peeth

rows.en: Turning in bed, stairs, standing on one leg
rows.ur: Karwat badalna, seedhiyan, ek taang par khara hona
Der tak kharay rehna, jhukna, baithna

rows.en: Thigh thrust, active straight leg raise, palpation of the long dorsal ligament
rows.ur: Thigh thrust, active straight leg raise, long dorsal ligament ka palpation

rows.en: Pelvic belt, balanced activity, stabilising exercise
rows.ur: Pelvic belt, mutawazin activity, stabilising exercise
Posture mein tabdeeli, chalna, halki strengthening

text.en: **Both sides equal.** Pelvic girdle pain settles when load is shared evenly: avoid standing on one leg, climbing many stairs at once and wide leg movements. Small changes make big differences.
text.ur: **Dono taraf barabar.** Pelvic girdle pain tab thamta hai jab load barabar baanta jaye: ek taang par kharay hone, ek saath bohat seedhiyan chadhne aur taangein bohat phailane se bachein. Chhoti tabdeeliyan bari farq daalti hain.

text.en: **Saying "it's only pregnancy" and doing nothing.** Pain in pregnancy is common but treatable. Telling a woman to wait can lead to months of avoidable pain and fear of moving. Explain, treat and review.
text.ur: **"Yeh sirf hamal hai" keh kar kuch na karna.** Hamal mein dard aam hai magar qabil-e-ilaaj. Intezaar ka kehna mahino ka bachaya ja sakne wala dard aur harkat ka dar paida kar sakta hai. Samjhayein, ilaj karein aur review karein.

question.en: Which symptom in a pregnant woman with back pain needs urgent medical review?
question.ur: Hamila aurat ko kamar dard ke saath kaun si alamat foran medical review maangti hai?

feedback.en: That is typical pelvic girdle pain.
feedback.ur: Yeh aam pelvic girdle pain hai.

text.en: Severe headache with swollen hands and face or blurred vision
text.ur: Shadeed sar dard, soojhe hue hath aur chehra ya dhundli nazar

feedback.en: Yes — these can be signs of pre-eclampsia and need urgent care.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh pre-eclampsia ki nishaniyan ho sakti hain aur foran care maangti hain.

text.ur: Der tak kharay rehne ke baad dard

question.en: Which advice suits pelvic girdle pain?
question.ur: Kaun sa mashwara pelvic girdle pain ke liye munasib hai?

text.en: Keep walking in short, comfortable spells and avoid wide leg positions and single-leg standing
text.ur: Chhote, aaram deh chakkar mein chalte rahein aur taangein phailane aur ek taang par kharay hone se bachein

feedback.en: Yes — gentle movement with even load keeps the joints calm.
feedback.ur: Haan — barabar load ke saath halki harkat joints ko pur-sukoon rakhti hai.

text.en: Complete bed rest until the baby is born
text.ur: Bachay ki paidaish tak mukammal bistar par aaram

feedback.en: Bed rest weakens the body and does not help.
feedback.ur: Bistar par aaram jism ko kamzor karta hai aur madad nahi karta.

text.en: Daily deep squats to strengthen the pelvis
text.ur: Pelvis mazboot karne ke liye rozana gehri squats

feedback.en: Deep squats can irritate the joints.
feedback.ur: Gehri squats joints ko chirchira kar sakti hain.

text.en: **Treat the fear as well.** Many women fear they are harming the baby by moving. Explain that gentle activity is safe, that the pain is not a sign of damage, and give clear limits ("walk ten minutes, then rest"). A belt worn low over the hips and a short exercise plan often give relief within weeks.
text.ur: **Dar ka bhi ilaj karein.** Bohat si khawateen ko dar hota hai ke harkat se bachay ko nuqsan hoga. Samjhayein ke halki activity mehfooz hai, dard nuqsan ki nishani nahi, aur saaf hadood dein ("das minute chalein, phir aaram"). Kulhon par neeche pehna hua belt aur chhota exercise plan aksar haftay mein sukoon deta hai.

question.en: Why is a pelvic support belt worn low over the hips rather than around the waist?
question.ur: Pelvic support belt kamar ke bajaye kulhon par neeche kyun pehna jata hai?

answer.en: Because it needs to compress the pelvic ring where the joints are, just above the hip bones and over the pubic bone, to steady them. Worn at the waist it presses on the abdomen and does not support the pelvic joints.
answer.ur: Kyunke isay pelvic halqe ko wahan dabana hai jahan joints hain, kulhay ki haddiyon ke bilkul oopar aur pubic haddi ke oopar, taake unhein sthir kare. Kamar par pehna jaye to yeh pait par dabao daalta hai aur pelvic joints ko sahara nahi deta.

beats.patient: A woman at 28 weeks has pain at the back of the right pelvis, worse climbing stairs and turning in bed. The thigh thrust test reproduces her pain; leg strength, sensation and reflexes are normal and she has no bleeding or headache.
beats.assessment: The pattern and test support pelvic girdle pain with no sign of a nerve or serious cause.
beats.treatment: Reassure, fit a pelvic belt, teach positions for turning and stairs, give gentle stabilising exercises and review in two weeks.
beats.reassess: At two weeks the pain is much less; she continues walking and keeps the belt for long days.

text.en: **Refer to the midwife or doctor** for vaginal bleeding, leaking fluid, regular tightening, reduced baby movements, severe headache, swelling of the face or hands, blurred vision, fever, burning urine, a hot swollen calf or severe pain after a fall. Numbness in the saddle area or loss of bladder or bowel control needs same-day emergency care.
text.ur: **Midwife ya doctor ko refer karein** vaginal bleeding, paani ka nikalna, baar baar sakhti, bachay ki harkat mein kami, shadeed sar dard, chehre ya hathon ki sujan, dhundli nazar, bukhar, peshab mein jalan, garam soojhi hui pindli ya girne ke baad shadeed dard. Saddle area mein sunn hona ya peshab ya pakhane par qaboo khona usi din emergency care maangta hai.

summary.en: Pelvic girdle pain sits between the pelvis and buttock and worsens with turning in bed, stairs and single-leg standing; lumbar pain is higher in the back.
summary.ur: Pelvic girdle pain pelvis aur kulhay ke beech hota hai aur karwat badalne, seedhiyon aur ek taang par kharay hone se barhta hai; lumbar dard peeth mein oopar hota hai.

summary.en: Use the thigh thrust test, active straight leg raise and ligament palpation, and screen for nerve involvement and pregnancy red flags first.
summary.ur: Thigh thrust test, active straight leg raise aur ligament palpation istemal karein, aur pehle nerve ke shamil hone aur hamal ki red flags screen karein.

summary.en: Treat with explanation, balanced loading, a pelvic belt worn low and gentle exercise; most pain settles after birth.
summary.ur: Wajah samjha kar, mutawazin loading, neeche pehne hue pelvic belt aur halki exercise se ilaj karein; zyada tar dard paidaish ke baad theek ho jata hai.

back.en: It improves after birth in most women.
back.ur: Zyada tar khawateen mein paidaish ke baad behtar ho jata hai.
